svg.title: The Giant's Causeway
svg.desc: Paper-cut scene: in warm golden evening light, Finn McCool, back in his green tunic and waving the baby bonnet over his head, and Oonagh stand on the Irish cliff, laughing together. At the foot of the cliff, a crowd of six-sided stone columns steps down into the sea: all that is left of the path, the Giant's Causeway. Far across the water, a few more columns stand at the Scottish shore.
